subject: EXIT statement
notes: CODE SITE DETAIL: ControlFlowBinder.cs#BindExit lines 258-267 - `if (ctx.CurrentSection is not { } sec) -> COBOL0827 'EXIT SECTION may be specified only in a section (ISO 14.9.14.3 SR9)'`. EDITIONS NOTE: EXIT SECTION is a COBOL-2002 introduction; ConstructRegistry row exit-section-2002 gates it below 2002 with COBOL0900. The only violating site the language admits is a paragraph that precedes every section header (§14.4.2: a section is a section header plus its paragraphs), and ctx.CurrentSection is exactly null there.
